title: Went from wondering if I could build a 3d world to building multiple and a ton of mini games
author: jontomato
selftext:
I went from wondering if I could build a 3d replica of my hometown to building out a whole experience with a ton of North Carolina towns (some a little hidden and one Seattle spot - which has a soft spot in my heart). I also made a bunch of fun mini games and experiences. Complete with realtime weather, events, seasons, and migratory animal behavior. Built on the back of tons and tons of open data that exists in the world. I spent quite a bit of time planning before building this out. That's kinda what I've seen as the key in building with AI.

Anyway, give it a try and let me know what you think!

[https://raleighterrarium.com/](https://raleighterrarium.com/)
